releases.name: RenderNorth Industrial Open Beta 0.1
releases.summary: RenderNorth Industrial Open Beta introduces a complete local-first industrial workflow for EVE Online, from character synchronization and production planning through market valuation, procurement, and doctrine fleet readiness.
added: Official CCP SSO through Authorization Code + PKCE
Human-readable station, structure, system, region, and container locations
Production cost, opportunity cost, cash requirement, profit, margin, and ROI
Quartermaster doctrine creation and EFT import
Official RenderNorth CCP application by default
CCP static-data download guidance and validation
Windows installer and portable package support
About, privacy, diagnostics, support, and contact information
changed: Navigation now shows only completed workflows in normal runtime
Development badges and internal controls are hidden unless debug mode is enabled
Quartermaster layout prioritizes fleet readiness and actionable results
Inventory and market search are separated into distinct workflows
Production economics use a selectable revenue basis
fixed: Inventory query failures no longer render as empty inventory
Unowned market searches no longer appear as zero-value inventory
Listed-sale unavailability no longer blocks immediate-sale profit calculations
Cost assumptions can now be applied, persisted, and reset
Resolvable raw location IDs now display as human-readable location paths
Quartermaster partial totals identify excluded or unresolved lines
Build shortages expand into manufacturing inputs without double-counting inventory
Static-data setup distinguishes ZIP selection, wrong folders, and incomplete extraction
knownIssues: Corporation assets are not yet supported
Corporation blueprints and industry jobs are not yet supported
Character market-order synchronization is not yet supported
Some beta testers may encounter a BPC selection issue in Production; investigation is pending
Build-location and jump-distance scope are not yet implemented
The installer is unsigned and may trigger Windows SmartScreen
Users must manually download and extract the CCP JSONL static-data archive
Automatic application updates are not yet implemented
Open Beta software may contain defects and incomplete workflows
security: Character authorization uses official CCP SSO with Authorization Code + PKCE
RenderNorth Industrial requests read-only ESI access and never automates gameplay
Application data remains in the local SQLite database
Refresh tokens remain in Windows Credential Manager and are never exposed to the frontend or diagnostics
The distributed official CCP application does not include a Client Secret
Exported diagnostics exclude access tokens, refresh tokens, Client IDs, and credentials
